attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OpenWrt) as DHCP server on the private network (eth1, 192.168.50.0/24) shared with node2/node3. node2 gets a static DHCP reservation (192.168.50.50) keyed to its eth1 MAC, so it always receives the same address across repeated leases; node3 is served from the general pool (192.168.50.100-150) and got 192.168.50.103. Verified with release/renew cycles before and after restarting all three nodes one at a time (boot-identity confirmed changed for each), and confirmed the config, service, and addressing all survived and recovered.
